powershell: $env:HTTP_PROXY=""; $env:HTTPS_PROXY=""; $env:NO_PROXY="*"; $urls = @("https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/web/simple/rapidocr-onnxruntime/","https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/rapidocr-onnxruntime/"); foreach($u in $urls){ try { $sw=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew(); $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 25; "OK $u status=" + $r.StatusCode + " bytes=" + $r.RawContentLength + " ms=" + [int]$sw.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds } catch { "FAIL $u :: " + $_.Exception.Message.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(80,$_.Exception.Message.Length)) } }; "py_alive=" + ((Get-Process python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count)
